mapper.select: SELECT CONVERT(CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS userId, DATE_FORMAT(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS registerDay, DATE_FORMAT(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS registerTime FROM ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info u WHERE u.create_time IS NOT NULL AND u.create_time >= #{from} AND u.create_time < #{to} AND (u.is_delete = 0 OR u.is_delete IS NULL) ORDER BY u.create_time LIMIT 100000

SELECT CONVERT(CAST(o.buyer_user_id AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS userId, o.order_status AS orderStatus, DATE_FORMAT(o.order_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS orderDay, DATE_FORMAT(o.order_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS orderTime, o.order_payment_amount AS amount FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base o WHERE o.order_create_time >= #{from} AND o.order_create_time < #{to} ORDER BY o.order_create_time LIMIT 200000

SELECT CONVERT(CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS userId, DATE_FORMAT(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS registerDay FROM ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info u WHERE (u.is_delete = 0 OR u.is_delete IS NULL) LIMIT 100000

SELECT CONVERT('login' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS src, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hou_log_login UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT('view' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci, COUNT(*) FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_user_footprint UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT('order' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci, COUNT(*) FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base
SELECT CONCAT('event_', e.event_type) AS src, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_behavior_event e GROUP BY e.event_type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_behavior_event (user_id, event_type, event_time, source, ref_id, ext) VALUES (#{userId}, #{eventType}, #{eventTime}, #{source}, #{refId}, #{ext})
